summary: Canonical MCP output-bounding contract: internal/mcp/envelope leaf package, flat envelope, PP_MCP_MAX_BYTES (default 32000), cobratree mirror paging, object-sibling preservation.
reason: Hand-written envelope/ and cobratree/paginate.go survive regen-merge, but the edits inside GENERATED tools.go, cobratree/shellout.go and cobratree/walker.go are silently reverted by regen-merge (mvanhorn/cli-printing-press#5418). Markers are call-site needles that appear only in the listed generated files (plus the leaf package), so ValidatePatchRecords aborts the merge if any wiring is dropped. Listed files are searched as a set: each needle must appear in at least one of them.

reapply: If regen-merge refuses naming this record: re-apply the envelope wiring. (1) internal/mcp/envelope/envelope.go and internal/mcp/cobratree/paginate.go are hand-written; restore from git history (commits d32760c, 6d7edc6 on readwise master). (2) In generated internal/mcp/tools.go: import readwise-pp-cli/internal/mcp/envelope; mcpToolResultText uses envelope.MaxBytes(); mcpBoundedSingleArrayObject calls envelope.ObjectArray(obj, arrayField, items, envelope.Options{...}); mcpBoundedListEnvelope/mcpOversizedPreviewEnvelope call envelope.List/envelope.Preview; boundedResultJSONWithCount wraps envelope.List; the watch-diff handler wraps envelope.ObjectArray(obj, "items", rawItems, ...); handleSearch returns boundedResultJSONWithCount(results, mcpToolResultMaxItems, "", totalCount, offset, true). (3) In internal/mcp/cobratree/shellout.go: mirrorMaxBytes() returns envelope.MaxBytes() and the handler returns paginateMirroredOutput(out, int(off), mirrorMaxBytes()). (4) In internal/mcp/cobratree/walker.go register the numeric `offset` option on each mirror tool. See mcp-unified-envelope-byte-budget.md for the contract and master's `git log -- internal/mcp` for the exact diffs.
